source.kind: hosted per-file wall time from shard receipt.json artifacts (Vitest reporter durationMs), maximum across every given run, Node job and shard on two forks, rounded up to integer ms; generated by scripts/ci-test-weights.mjs refresh; scheduling weights, not an end-to-end performance claim
source.note: headSha is the commit each receipt tested (a pull_request run tests its merge commit). Zero-duration all-skipped files have no positive weight, use the partitionTests observed-median fallback and are not drift. Failed-file timing is retained as cost, not acceptance.
